# OmniSec Tester

> Deterministic agentic security scanner. Crawls, discovers attack surface,
> probes with rate limits, validates reflections with executable curl PoCs.
> Zero-cost core; optional LLM narrative layer.

## Commands
- `omnisectester scan web <target>` — agent scan (headers, TLS, sensitive paths, reflected XSS via discovered params/forms)
- `omnisectester severity <cve>` — live CVSS from NVD
- `omnisectester threat-model <target>` — observation-driven STRIDE rows
- `omnisectester engage <target>` — threat-model-first full chain + reports
- `omnisectester sbom <dir> --vulns` — CycloneDX 1.5 + OSV.dev matching
- `omnisectester report <result.json>` — md/html/json
- `omnisectester verify-tools --strict` — environment CI gate

## Machine contract
- One JSON object on stdout; findings sorted by severity
- Finding shape: {id, title, severity, evidence, remediation, cwe}; reflections include executable curl `poc`
- Exit: 0 clean · 1 failure · 2 findings met --fail-on threshold

## Flags (scan)
--rate-limit --max-pages --fail-on --include-subdomains --exclude --auth/--auth-token --format --llm

## Ethics
Only scan targets you own or are authorized to test.
